text: The 2025 Annual Plan is presented for Board consideration and approval. The plan is guided by the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Strategic Directions 2024-2030 and organized into four focus areas which account for the largest sources of carbon emissions in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area: accelerating deep retrofits, accelerating uptake of electric vehicles, advancing net-zero ready new construction, and accelerating clean electrification.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the 2025 Annual Plan as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (February 3, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
